sentences.en: The chocolate cake tempted her even though she was dieting.
sentences.zh: 尽管她在节食，巧克力蛋糕还是诱惑了她。

sentences.en: Can I tempt you to try another piece of cake?
sentences.zh: 我能请你再尝一块蛋糕吗？

sentences.en: People are sometimes tempted to eat more than they should.
sentences.zh: 人们有时会忍不住多吃一些。

senses.zh: 引诱，怂恿,吸引,冒…的风险,使感兴趣vi.有吸引力
